author: Goon7
quote: How disappointing. While the graphics are great, the game is much more boring than GTA V. It's simply not fun to play, and honestly, the story didn't convince me at all. I'm not sure I'd go as far as calling it a bad game, but it's certainly not what I expected. And there's absolutely no way this deserves a 99. It honestly makes me question the judgment of the people who gave it that score.
